summary: On a plain "add a basic checkbox, nothing fancy" request, Claude Code immediately loaded the brainstorming skill and opened a scoping question menu instead of editing the page. No checkbox was written.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria failed: brainstorming was invoked (confirmed in the session JSONL) and no checkbox was implemented (index.html contains no 'checkbox' string). This is exactly the over-trigger cost pattern the scenario measures.

observations.description: Brainstorming skill over-triggers: a one-line mechanical UI request ("basic checkbox with on/off state, nothing fancy") loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, a Read and a Bash call, and produced a 3-option design menu rather than an edit.

The agent itself classified the task as 'bounded — a small, well-scoped change to a single static HTML file' yet still ran the brainstorming flow and blocked on a question, which reads as internally inconsistent.
Startup required four interactive dialogs (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) despite the HOWTO stating the isolated home is seeded with dialog-bypass state.

coding-agent-token-usage.json (the headline cost artifact named in the scenario) does not exist in the results directory after the session; only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home, phase.json are present.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Screen after the single request: "⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill" then "Classifying this as bounded ..." and a menu "☐ Scope — The page's <main> is empty ... What should the checkbox attach to? 1. Checkbox + label per item (Recommended) ...". `grep -c checkbox coding-agent-workdir/index.html` returned 0 — no checkbox markup was written.

grep over the session log: `grep -o '"name":"Skill","input":{[^}]*}' home/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl` → "name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming","args":"Add a basic on/off checkbox component to the tasks page"} (plugin is named hyperpowers here; it is the brainstorming skill).
